title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
☀️ Good morning, Matthew! It's Thursday, November 5, 2026.

🌤️ Weather
Warm and cloudy for November. It's around 60°F early, with a high near 72°F and a low near 59°F. There's about a 30% chance of showers, mostly before 1pm. Rain moves in tonight (around 80%), and Friday looks wet, with 1–2 inches possible.
What to wear/bring: Light layers, no heavy coat. Bring a compact umbrella for tonight.

🗞️ Headlines
• Midterms: Democrats have won control of both the House and the Senate. Hakeem Jeffries has formally launched his bid for Speaker.
• VP JD Vance says the Iran war is the 'obvious' reason Republicans lost. Trump called that 'largely true' but said he'd do it again.
• Senate races: James Talarico won in Texas. A razor-thin Mississippi race is headed for a recount.
• NYC: A three-alarm house fire in Sunset Park, Brooklyn, overnight killed 6 people and injured 7.
• World: France deployed about 70,000 police for nationwide strikes and protests. Russia and Ukraine have resumed talks even as airstrikes continue.

🚇 Getting around
• No major subway disruptions reported for this morning yet. Check the MYmta app before you leave.
• Coming this weekend: Starting Saturday, Nov 7 at 12:30am, A trains won't run between Rockaway Blvd and Ozone Park–Lefferts Blvd until 5am Monday, Nov 16. Free shuttle buses will replace them. This is part of the $1.9B A/C signal and track upgrade.

🎉 NYC today
• Michelle Branch plays the Beacon Theatre at 8pm.
• At Carnegie Hall, the Orchestra of St. Luke's performs Berlioz's Symphonie fantastique in Stern Auditorium, and Alisa Weilerstein performs her FRAGMENTS series in Zankel Hall.

💡 Nugget
OMNY has a weekly fare cap. After 12 paid subway or local bus rides in any 7-day period on the same card or phone, the rest of your rides that week are free. Tapping the same card every time is how you get it.
